notes.title: Announcing Kingdom Clicker!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506543/4afa65c3638ea60f954620eec9037120ffce1fa3.jpg[/img]

Are you ready for the next generation in medieval clicker games?
Your king needs you! Build the kingdom and earn money with just your finger! Try to get all the achievements and restore the honor of your empire.

Kingdom Clicker will be available at March 30th.
[h1][url=store.steampowered.com/app/816060] Steampage [/url][/h1]
